description.en: Six monochrome actions spring inward with a short clockwise stagger, framed by fine grey rims, white highlights, and soft shadows; all scatter out together on close.
description.zh: 黑色图标随短暂顺时针错峰收拢成环，保留细灰边、白色高光与柔和阴影，关闭时六项一起向外散开。

keywords: 柔光 浅色 环形 菜单 展开 细边 高光 阴影 模糊 弹簧 action wheel soft neumorphic radial menu

discovery.caveat: 替换演示操作，检查展开后按钮与页面边界的间距。

source.implementation: Variant of the local native radial-menu core, with independently reconstructed SVGs and light-surface styling; no original author source obtained.
source.license: Original design license not supplied or independently verified; the reference video is retained only for internal comparison.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click + to reveal the actions, or × to scatter them out. Keyboard and touch are supported; each action records a local choice without opening another application.
instructions.zh: 点击 + 展开，点击 × 向外散开收起。支持键盘与触屏，菜单操作只记录本地选择，不打开其他应用。
